Summary: The only change from [version_no] to [version_no] was the introduction of a cloud service (currently only AWS). Search the forum for related issues. analysis.insight_summary: Users voice significant dissatisfaction with the [product_name] [version_no], especially regarding new cloud features that resulted in unexpected problems, such as reduced custom HTTP page performance. There is a perception that the primary change from [version_no] to [version_no] was AWS integration, with few notable improvements and additional complications. However, one user cites high overall quality for both the product and its software and suggests most issues are due to outdated firmware or software. The discussion centers on performance drops, cloud feature focus, and firmware update processes.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect upgrades to enhance performance and functionality without introducing new problems, particularly regarding reliability and essential features such as custom HTTP servicing. Transparency and meaningful improvements in new software or firmware versions are also expected.
